control_rule: The weekly OMI fixture reporting period is user-advised and must be explicitly locked. Scheduled refreshes may refresh provider data inside the locked period, but must never redefine the reporting period from the current date or a rolling lookahead.
refresh_rule: Provider refresh is permitted hourly, but admission is constrained to the locked report period and future kickoffs for the upcoming prediction surface.
change_rule: A new reporting period requires an explicit control-plane update; it must not be inferred from runtime date.
